title: Astra · controls study v2 pair 2 · keyboard · 1–128

action.intent: Inspect population, food, drink, and fortress status before assigning work.
Return to the map and open designations to begin gathering wood and excavating shelter.
Designate trees northwest of the cursor for an initial supply of timber.
Designate an entrance staircase near the wagon and inspect the level below.
Designate the lower staircase and an adjoining underground room, then let the dwarves work.
Open the carpenter workshop placement menu to start producing beds and barrels.
Place the carpenter's workshop on the excavated floor and inspect material selection.
Select a log for the carpenter's workshop and let dwarves construct it.
Leave the build menu and let dwarves construct the carpenter's workshop and finish mining.
Inspect the carpenter workshop and open its available jobs.
Queue seven beds and three barrels at the completed carpenter's workshop.
Excavate a southern room for farming and essential workshops while the carpenter makes beds and barrels.
Open farm plot placement to establish a renewable food and brewing supply.
Position a 3×3 farm plot on the excavated floor and check soil suitability.
Place the valid 3×3 underground farm and let construction and mining proceed.
Inspect the new farm plot and its planting options.
Select plump helmets and assign them to every season.
Select plump helmets and assign them to all seasons.
Keep plump helmets planted all year and begin placing a still for brewing.
Confirm the still location and inspect available construction materials.
Select a log to queue construction of the still.
Select a fishery to support the fortress's two fishery workers.
Place the fishery beside the carpenter in the excavated northern room.
Select wood for the fishery and let dwarves construct the queued workshops and furniture.
Inspect the completed still and its available brewing jobs.
Inspect available still jobs to start alcohol production.
Try adding plant brewing at the still and inspect whether ingredients or containers block it.
Return to the fortress and let carpenters finish the barrels needed for brewing.
Inspect the still and check whether brewing can now be queued.
Open still task menu to queue brewing.
Inspect the brewing requirements to identify what is preventing drink production.
Return to the fortress view to check barrel production.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop for unfinished barrel jobs.
Prioritize a barrel for brewing and let workshop production proceed.
Inspect the still and available brewing jobs now that barrel production has advanced.
Check what is preventing plant brewing at the still.
Exit the brewing requirement screen and allow carpenters to finish empty barrels.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs and barrel production.
Inspect brewing jobs now that the carpenter has completed a barrel.
Queue repeating plant brewing, then begin placing beds.
Place the first bed in the southern room.
Select the willow bed for installation at (21,27).
Place the remaining six beds beside the first bed.
Let dwarves install the seven queued beds and continue food production.
Inspect a completed bed and start defining a shared sleeping room.
Expand the bedroom to encompass the beds, then inspect its room settings.
Enable the shared dormitory and inspect brewing at the still.
Create an underground food stockpile beside the workshops and let dwarves haul supplies and brew.
Inspect citizens and their jobs to identify available farming and brewing workers.
Inspect the expedition leader's labors to ensure brewing is staffed; planting is already active.
Return from Udib's overview to access native labor controls.
Locate Udib and open labor preferences to check brewing availability.
Inspect Udib's farming labors to enable brewing.
Return to the citizens list to select a dwarf for brewing labor.
Inspect the expedition leader to assign brewing labor.
Return to the citizen list and locate Udib on the map for labor assignment.
Open Udib's farming labors to assign brewing.
Open the citizen list to select a dwarf for brewing labor; current selection is a horse.
Select Udib and inspect native labor preferences to assign brewing.
Return to the unit list and zoom to Udib to access labor settings.
Locate Udib and open labor preferences to assign brewing.
Open Udib's farming labors to enable brewing.
Select and enable Brewing for Udib.
Brewing is enabled for Udib; leave the labor menus to resume fortress work.
Resume the fortress so the newly enabled brewer and farmers can work.
Inspect underground workshops to produce more empty barrels after brewing ran out of containers.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect available jobs to replenish barrels.
Queue eight wooden barrels and let the carpenter produce storage for brewing.
Inspect the still and restore brewing now that barrel production has had time to progress.
Open the still job menu to restart brewing.
Queue repeating plant brewing and let dwarves work.
Check food and drink reserves after brewing ran out of suitable plants.
Inspect the farm configuration now that reserves show 100 drinks but no plants.
Inspect the farm plot and verify its crop selection.
Set plump helmets for all seasons and let planting proceed.
Inspect the farm plot and its planting settings.
Inspect the blue tiles near the farm to determine whether the fortress is flooding.
Check whether cavern water has reached the farm before planning flood containment.
Observe whether the shallow water continues spreading while farmers work.
Inspect the surface for a safe replacement fortress site as floodwater spreads through the underground rooms.
Open plant-gathering designations to establish a surface food supply.
Designate surface plants for gathering to restore food and brewing supplies.
Open still placement to rebuild brewing on the dry surface.
Move the surface still to a clearer site and select construction material.
Select an apple wood log to construct the surface still.
Let dwarves construct the surface still and gather designated plants.
Inspect the surface still and its available jobs.
Open the completed surface still's job menu to start brewing.
Attempt to queue brewing at the surface still and inspect whether ingredients permit it.
Exit the unavailable brewing recipe and return to the fortress view.
Resume the fortress so dwarves can gather the designated plants and carry out pending work.
Inspect citizens and their current jobs to resolve stalled plant gathering.
Locate the plant gatherer to inspect surface work and nearby stockpile space.
Open food stockpile designation to establish safe surface storage near the still.
Create a surface food stockpile near the still and allow gathering and hauling to proceed.
Inspect the surface still and available brewing jobs.
Inspect available brewing jobs at the completed surface still.
Let plant gathering and hauling proceed before checking food production.
Inspect jobs to determine why five dwarves remain idle while gathering is pending.
Locate the active plant gatherer and allow harvesting to progress.
Leave the dwarf inspection and unpause so plant gathering can progress.
Place a surface carpenter's workshop to replace flooded production.
Place the surface carpenter's workshop and inspect available construction materials.
Select wood for the surface carpenter's workshop and allow construction and gathering to proceed.
Exit the build menu and let gathering and construction proceed.
Inspect the surface carpenter workshop and its construction status.
Inspect carpenter tasks to queue essential barrels and furniture.
Queue six barrels at the surface carpenter for food storage and brewing.
Let dwarves produce the six confirmed barrel jobs and gather food on the surface.
Open bed placement to establish safe surface sleeping space.
Leave bed placement and inspect the surface carpenter to produce replacement beds.
Queue five replacement beds at the surface carpenter and let dwarves work.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs and bed production.
Prioritize replacement beds for the flooded sleeping area and allow carpentry to proceed.
Check whether completed beds are available for surface sleeping quarters.
Let the carpenter finish queued beds and gatherers collect food.
Check whether completed beds are now available for surface housing.
Place a surface bed west of the carpenter workshop.
Start a separate sheltered dormitory north of the flooded rooms; beds must be indoors.
Inspect the layer beneath the new entrance and designate its matching up stair.
Designate a replacement upstairs and a compact room west of it, safely away from the flooded fortress, then let miners work.
Inspect the surface access stair while allowing mining and bed production to proceed.
Inspect citizens and their current jobs to diagnose stalled excavation.
Locate the active miner and inspect excavation progress.
Let the miner finish the dry shelter and allow queued beds to be produced.
Place beds in the completed dry underground room.
Place a bed along the east side of the dry underground room.
Select an available bed for installation in the dry underground room.
